complexity_drivers: Protheus governance model (TI+Jurídico+DPO tri-party meeting — Gap G1002 blocker), Slack EKM deployment (AWS KMS master keys under CISO control for instant revocation), 7-system audit trail orchestration (Protheus + Pronto + CRM Totvs + Clarity + Conexão + Teams + SEI — every API call logged: user ID + timestamp + query/mutation + response status), LGPD/TCU compliance (5-year audit log retention), alçadas approval workflow (R$ 2M threshold → Slack button routing to authorized approver), multi-persona CM (B2B clientes, executivos, comercial, N1/N2 — training matrix by persona, adoption KPIs, executive mandate Saulo), Experience Design workstream (UX research F1 pilot with 20-50 users, service design, accessibility WCAG 2.1 AA), Governance/CoE workstream (RACI by system, data stewardship, CoE charter, decision rights)
skills_needed: Salesforce security architect (Protheus governance model + audit trail + EKM + alçadas approval workflow), MuleSoft architect (7-system audit trail orchestration), Slack admin (Enterprise Grid + EKM config), Salesforce admin (audit log custom object + adoption monitoring dashboard + Flow alçadas routing), CM lead (training matrix by persona + adoption KPIs + executive mandate orchestration), UX researcher (Experience Design workstream — F1 pilot usability testing with 20-50 users), service designer (conversational flow design + Slack Canvas UX), accessibility specialist (WCAG 2.1 AA audit), CoE lead (RACI by system + data stewardship + CoE charter)
risks: Protheus governance blocker (Gap G1002) — TI+Jurídico+DPO tri-party meeting must complete before F1 kick-off; escalate to seller immediately. Experience Design gap (6 gaps) — no UX research/service design/content strategy scoped; risk of low adoption, high support burden, accessibility non-compliance (10k+ external users). Governance/CoE gap (5 gaps) — multi-team ownership RACI undefined (Agentforce config, MuleSoft APIs, Slack admin), data stewardship (CRM Totvs vs. Salesforce truth?), CoE structure, CM execution plan. CM execution risk — 10k+ users onboarding without structured training → low adoption → F1/F2/F3 ROI failure. Slack EKM new technology — limited production precedent, may require vendor support engagement.
solution_approach: MuleSoft audit trail: every API call (Protheus + Pronto + CRM Totvs + Clarity + Conexão + Teams) logged to Salesforce custom object (user ID + timestamp + query/mutation + response status) — 5-year retention for LGPD/TCU compliance. Protheus governance: TI+Jurídico+DPO tri-party meeting defines perfil de acesso per user before F1 kick-off (Gap G1002 blocker). Slack EKM: AWS KMS master keys under Dataprev CISO control — instant revocation capability (motivated by prior 2.8M CPF breach). Alçadas approval workflow: KB Normativas (J7) surfaces alçadas R$ 2M → Salesforce Flow routes to authorized approver via Slack button → logs approval. Multi-persona CM: training matrix (B2B clientes, executivos, comercial, N1/N2), early adopters (20-50 pilot users F1), executive mandate (Saulo enforces adoption KPIs >60% uso semanal F2). Experience Design workstream: UX researcher + service designer embedded F1 (J1/J2 usability testing with pilot) → iterate conversational flows + Slack Canvas UX F1 → scale F2/F3. Governance/CoE workstream: RACI by system (Protheus → TI owner, CRM Totvs → Comercial owner, Agentforce → PS delivery team owner F1, handoff to CoE F2), CoE charter (roles, decision rights, change approval process), data stewardship (CRM Totvs vs. Salesforce truth decision).
